options.content:
### Node area — host fault ledger
Everything the GB300 trays report about themselves that is **not** a GPU: filesystem fill, run-queue load, memory pressure, kernel and EDAC faults, and the trays' own adapter counters. Sourced entirely from `node_exporter` pushed by each tray.

**Every tile below is followed by a table built from the identical expression — the tile's number is that table's row count.**

**Node area**  ·  **Host faults (you are here)**  ·  [Tray roster — reporting, silent, per-rack coverage](/d/nvis-nodes-detail)  ·  [Tray deep dive — one tray in full](/d/nvis-node-deep-dive)  ·  [GPU health — XID, ECC, thermal, power](/d/gpu-health)

panels.title: Host fault ledger — the offender list for each tile is directly beneath it

panels.description: Counted once per tray per signal: OOM kill in the last 6 h, EDAC memory ECC error, read-only filesystem, filesystem device error. The table below has exactly one row per signal counted here.

targets.expr: count(label_replace(max by(node,rack,su)(increase(node_vmstat_oom_kill{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}[6h])) > 0,"signal","OOM kills (6 h)","","") or label_replace(max by(node,rack,su)(node_edac_correctable_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}) > 0,"signal","Memory ECC correctable","","") or label_replace(max by(node,rack,su)(node_edac_uncorrectable_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}) > 0,"signal","Memory ECC uncorrectable","","") or label_replace(max by(node,rack,su)(node_filesystem_readonly{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}) > 0,"signal","Filesystem read-only","","") or label_replace(max by(node,rack,su)(node_filesystem_device_error{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}) > 0,"signal","Filesystem device error","","")) or vector(0)

panels.title: Kernel-level fault signals

panels.description: Local disks only (ext*/xfs/btrfs/vfat). Shared NFS mounts are the same volume on every tray and would be counted once per tray.
panels.title: Local filesystems over 85 % full

panels.description: Kernel PSI: trays where some task spent more than 5 % of the last 5 minutes waiting on I/O.
panels.title: Trays stalled on I/O

panels.description: Kernel PSI: trays where some task spent more than 5 % of the last 5 minutes waiting for a CPU. Cheaper and more direct than load average, which needs the tray's core count.
panels.title: Trays stalled on CPU

panels.description: 1 - MemAvailable/MemTotal. MemAvailable already discounts reclaimable page cache, so this is real pressure.
panels.title: Trays above 85 % memory used

panels.description: Counted once per port per signal. Lifetime counters read by node_exporter on the tray itself — this is the host adapter's own view, not switch telemetry.

targets.expr: count(label_replace(node_infiniband_link_downed_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0,"signal","Link downed","","") or label_replace(node_infiniband_port_errors_received_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0,"signal","Port errors received","","") or label_replace(node_infiniband_symbol_error_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0,"signal","Symbol errors","","") or label_replace(node_infiniband_local_link_integrity_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0,"signal","Local link integrity","","") or label_replace(node_infiniband_port_receive_remote_physical_errors_total{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} > 0,"signal","Remote physical errors","","")) or vector(0)

Headroom — the closest trays and mounts, whether or not they have tripped

panels.description: Always 25 rows so the trend is visible before anything breaches 85 %. This is a headroom view, not the offender list for a tile.

defaults.noValue: No tray in this selection is reporting a local filesystem.

panels.title: Fullest local filesystems — top 25

panels.description: Ranked by 1-minute load, with the CPU-stall, I/O-stall and memory-used figures for the same 25 trays. This is the host-pressure roster for the node area; the fleet 'Peak host load' tile and its own top-25 live on the Live Topology board.

targets.expr: max by(node)(100 * (1 - node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"} / node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"})) and on(node) topk(25, max by(node,rack,su)(node_load1{cluster=~"$cluster",datahall=~"$datahall",su=~"$su",rack=~"$rack"}))
